title: Oscar Wolfe deathbed interview about S4 autopsy film and gray alien

tellings.quote: when I brought Richard Dolan in to interview this man as he was dying on like I think it was like a dialysis machine

plain: A dying man named Oscar Wolfe gave an interview about S4, a secret site near Area 51 in Nevada, where he said he had seen an autopsy film of a gray alien. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he brought in the UFO historian Richard Dolan to interview Wolfe "as he was dying on like I think it was like a dialysis machine." Corbell points to Wolfe's DD-214s, the US military's discharge papers, as backing for his service record.
